context: The agent must wire -main in widget_service/main.clj to call the widget component's start-widget-processor. Both widget/interface.clj (public, delegates) and widget/core.clj (private impl) are given as inputs, presented neutrally with no statement of which is correct to require. Key discriminator: without the idiom, an agent may require com.repldriven.mono.widget.core directly since it holds the visible implementation; with the idiom loaded, it knows a base reaches a component only through its interface.clj, the same rule as component-to-component. A second, independent discriminator: whether -main and (:gen-class) are actually present, since a base's whole job is to be a runnable Java entry point.
